description: Capability Ledger template. Standing ledger: knowledge/capabilities.json (per-repository toolchain, approved at the DoD gate). Goal-scoped ledger: .ai/capabilities.json (expires automatically with .ai/). Entries are written by the HUMAN on approving a queued decision. The Runtime concatenates the 'allow' arrays verbatim - exact rule strings the human approved - and never translates or expands them.

entries.intent: EXAMPLE - survive a mid-run machine failure and allow review from another device (ADR-011)
entries.command: git push of the Loop Branch only
entries.scope: the loop/* branch of this repository; never the default branch
